result.topic_en: Scattered notes on a linear differential equation with a singular point where the leading coefficient vanishes (differentiating it and comparing coefficients), together with sketches of a Riemann surface, a theta function, a period matrix, and the bilinear relation among periods of abelian integrals.

methods.what: Homogeneous linear ordinary differential equation of order n with singular point where leading coefficient vanishes
methods.quote: $a_0 \frac{\partial^n y}{\partial x^n} + a_1 \frac{\partial^{n-1} y}{\partial x^{n-1}} + \cdots + y a_n = 0$

methods.what: Differentiating the linear ODE to obtain an equation of order n+1
Condition that the differentiated equation is proportional to the original (coefficient ratios equal)
Linear combination of abelian integrals of the first kind
Normalized period matrix with diagonal \pi i
Symmetry of period matrix and Riemann bilinear relation between periods of two integrals
